title: Auto-Alpha: A Framework for Autonomous Factor Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.25732v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous factor research requires generating economic hypotheses as well as implementing and testing them. We present Auto-Alpha, a framework that connects report-guided initialization to self-directed research through a test-driven implementation loop. An idea agent proposes economic mechanisms and signal constructions; a research agent develops them with backtest feedback. Semantic audit, quantitative review, and human admission select factors for a persistent library, while an Experience Library retains research insights. Starting from 120 research reports, Auto-Alpha builds an initial library of 32 factors. It then generates new ideas and refines existing candidates, producing 420 implementations and retaining 62 additional factors. We evaluate factor quality and portfolio performance using a fixed library snapshot of 105 factors. The median 1-day Rank IC is 0.0301, and a weekly Top-300 portfolio returns 16.81% annualized after s

translated_title: Auto-Alpha：一个自主因子研究框架
translated_abstract: 自主因子研究既需要生成经济学假设，也需要对其实施和检验。我们提出Auto-Alpha，一个通过测试驱动的实现循环将“报告引导的初始化”与“自主探索研究”相连接的框架。一个想法智能体提出经济机制与信号构造；一个研究智能体则结合回测反馈对其进行开发。通过语义审计、量化审查和人工准入，筛选出的因子进入一个持久化的因子库，同时一个经验库用于沉淀研究洞见。从120份研究报告出发，Auto-Alpha构建了包含32个因子的初始因子库。随后它持续生成新想法并改进现有候选因子，共产出420个实现，并额外保留62个因子。我们基于包含105个因子的固定库快照来评估因子质量与组合表现：1日Rank IC中位数为0.0301，周频Top-300组合年化收益达16.81%（扣除……后）。（注：摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: Auto-Alpha是一个通过测试驱动的实现循环将报告引导的初始化与自主探索研究相结合的多智能体因子研究框架，借助多重审查机制与经验库持续构建并优化因子库，其因子中位1日Rank IC达0.0301，周频Top-300组合年化收益达16.81%。
en_tdlr: Auto-Alpha is a multi-agent autonomous factor research framework that links report-guided initialization to self-directed exploration via a test-driven implementation loop, iteratively building a curated factor library that achieves a median 1-day Rank IC of 0.0301 and 16.81% annualized returns on a weekly Top-300 portfolio.
